title: Nautical Quest Adventures & Boat Rentals

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Be your own captain and explore the inshore mangroves and waterways of Key Largo. Anchor up with just you and your special someone. With a little instruction, you can safely learn to navigate the local waters. Boat rentals start at $2200 and go up from there, depending on the size and amount of time you rent the vessel. Please call for availability and pricing. All boats are 2020 and newer. Cancellation policy: Boat Rentals will be charged $200.00 if canceled within 72 hours of the scheduled departure time or in the event of a no-show, the deposit will be forfeited. Credit cards will incur an additional 2.5% charge to cover card fees. Any weather-related cancellations will not incur a fee,

services.name: Family fishing adventure
services.desc: This is my first repeat guests on the Nautical Quest. After the first adventure this family had on the water, they just had to go out again on the next day. These charters make incredible family memories. So with the 20 knot winds, we headed out to the reef patches with live shrimp. As an experienced Captain in the area, I knew just how to position the boat on Carey’s Fort Reef to block the large waves, allowing the family to have a pleasurable fishing experience. The kids had a blast catching yellow tail and mutton snapper. This was another successful charter adventure, with the whole family having a wonderful day fishing in the beautiful Florida
